Recent notes

  • Pair vertices as a capsule image 2026-09-13N_TOFMicromegasImagingTracking

    How a vertex is built from two tracks, a 3D density of the campaign pair vertices against a no-source null, and how blurred the capsule image is: a real image in x (centre -9.4 mm vs -9.3 from single tracks, sigma ~16 mm), none in z.

  • The pair vertex along the beam 2026-09-13N_TOFMicromegasImagingTracking

    The three y peaks were an averaging artefact (a good A/C-leg y with a junk D-leg y). With y from the legs that measure it and the y plane cleaned, pairs and single tracks put the capsule at y ~ +30 mm with a ~28 mm blur; the y angle scale is bracketed, not calibrated.

  • Two-track vertices in 3D, and same-chamber pairs 2026-09-13N_TOFMicromegasImagingTracking

    Every clean pair in one 3D density: the A-D/C-D x slab and the D-D z slab at equal weight cross 5.5 mm from the capsule at 10 sigma. Same-chamber pairs show no common vertex, but the test is blind: a second track in the chamber makes both 3-4x worse in y, and close tracks are reconstructed as one.

  • Where the z of the pair image went 2026-09-13N_TOFMicromegasImagingTracking

    Why every pair-vertex map with z in it is uncorrelated: chamber D (noisy columns, unmeasured slopes, a dead z band). Cleaning D does not rescue A-D/C-D z; D-D pairs image z, A-C weakly, A-A and C-C not at all; aligning A and C does not move A-C z.

  • X17 preliminary analysis — plan and status 2026-09-07AnalysisN_TOF

    The plan of record for the first end-to-end pass over the 2026 n_TOF campaign: the chain stage by stage, what it will not establish, and what is deferred to October.

  • The P2 bulk pillars, resolved 2026-08-25Beam testMicromegasURWELLEfficiencyPillarsP2 basket

    The uRWELL reference points to 0.22 mm at the P2 planes and images the bulk pillar lattice: triangular, 2.995 mm, effective 0.77 mm, and worth 9.5 points of P2_IN's efficiency.
